item.title: Initial OAuth2.0 support
item.description: The Authentication Helper add-on now ships with an OAuth2 authentication method for the non-interactive grant types: client_credentials and password. This is an early release and we want your feedback. Here’s what’s done, what isn’t, and what’s coming next.
